## Introduction: What is reproducibility?

There are different, conflicting definitions of what reproducibility is.
However, for this course we will take the following definition:

*Reproducible*: Performing the same analysis on the same data produces the same 
results



## Where do we go from here...

Throughout the rest of this session, we will walk through the steps that we can
take to an ad-hoc collection of scripts into a reproducible scientific workflow
